ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Creation Activity From Fake Recycle.Bin Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects file write event from/to a fake recycle bin folder that is often used as a staging directory for malware

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*RECYCLERS\\\.BIN\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*RECYCLER\\\.BIN\\\\.*")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*RECYCLERS\\\.BIN\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*RECYCLER\\\.BIN\\\\.*")))
